subject: Align demo to CTO evening window — split session & sponsor coverage
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brookline.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@brookline.ai>
Date: 2025-11-15T20:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: Can we move demo to match CTO availability?

Hi Nikhil + Laura,

Thanks again for the invite — the team is very interested. Quick heads up: our CTO, Anil Rao, just got booked on travel that lands him in late on 11/19 and he's only available for exec Q&A after 6pm ET that evening. He specifically asked to join the executive portion to evaluate architecture/ops.

Would you be able to split the session so the technical walkthrough runs earlier (60–75m) and the CTO Q&A runs as a short exec block later the same day (30m)? If not possible, can we move the full meeting to 11/20 after 5:30pm ET? We can be flexible but need the CTO present for the final decision.

I attached a quick org chart for reference.

— Sophie
Sophie Turner
Senior Director, Product 
Brookline AI

Attachment: org-chart.pdf

-----
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brookline.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-15T21:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Can we move demo to match CTO availability?

Thanks, Sophie — completely reasonable ask. We can do a split session the same day to accommodate Anil's evening window. Proposed plan:

- Option A (preferred): 11/19 — 4:00–5:15pm ET (technical deep-dive, Marissa leads, hands-on infra + perf) + 6:00–6:30pm ET (exec Q&A, Nikhil + CTO join)
- Option B: Move whole slot to 11/20 — 5:30–7:00pm ET

If you confirm Option A, we'll send two calendar invites and a short mutual action plan. We'll include a fallback policy: if Anil's flight is delayed, we can run the technical portion and hold the exec Q&A the next day or run a 20-minute async briefing with recorded highlights.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan so your procurement team can see milestones. Laura, can you seed the exec invite and include the product one? Marissa — you'll own the tech deck and hands-on portion.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx

-----
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brookline.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Procurement Ops <procurement@brookline.ai>
Date: 2025-11-15T22:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Can we move demo to match CTO availability?

Option A works for us — split session is ideal. Please do send two invites. Quick notes from our side:

- Anil confirmed 6:00–6:30pm ET for the exec block on 11/19, he asked that the team surface expected SLAs, data residency notes, and a short fallback plan if we need to run without him.
- We'll have Priya (VP Product) join the exec Q&A as well.
- Can you share the deck and any pre-reads so Anil has context before boarding his flight?

Appreciate the fallback options — procurement copied for scheduling/PO visibility.

Best,
Sophie

-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@brookline.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-16T09:00:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Can we move demo to match CTO availability?

Thanks Sophie — booking confirmed.

I just sent two calendar invites:
- 11/19 16:00–17:15 ET — Technical deep-dive (Marissa leads, link + dial-in in invite)
- 11/19 18:00–18:30 ET — Exec Q&A (Nikhil + Redwood CTO on standby)

Marissa will own the hands-on notebook and we'll attach the demo deck + short recording link afterward. Nikhil will join the exec block and stand by if Anil's flight is delayed; we've also created a 20-min async briefing with highlights that we can push to Anil immediately after the tech session if needed.

Attachments: demo-deck.pdf

Calendar invites: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-60 (private invites sent directly)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BRK-12345

Let us know if anything else — looking forward to the session.
